sources.title: Transformers vs. Convolutional Neural Networks: What's the Difference ...
sources.snippet: The key difference between transformers and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) lies in how they solve challenges. A transformer model is a neural network that uses an encoder-decoder architecture to recognize patterns in data. sources.title: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) in Deep Learning
sources.snippet: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are deep learning models designed to process data with a grid-like topology such as images. They are the foundation for most modern computer vision applications to detect features within visual data.
